transcript: Be patient when you're becoming someone you've never been. Of course it's going to feel uncomfortable. You're stepping into a version of yourself that your body has no memory of. Your nervous system and subconscious only know how to survive through old patterns. The overthinking, the people pleasing, shrinking yourself so no one gets upset. So when you finally start choosing you, setting boundaries and speaking your truth, your system is going to freak out. It's going to tell you that you're selfish. It's going to try to pull you back into familiar chaos. Not because you're failing, but because your body has been trained to equate comfort with suffering. That's why change feels like danger. That's why healing can feel like you're losing yourself. You're not. You're simply meeting the parts of you that never got the chance to exist. So if you feel lost, confused or doubtful, that's actually a good place to be. You're not going backwards. You're crossing the threshold into who you were always meant to become. If this spoke to you, comment myself below. Share this with someone who needs it. And if you're ready to start healing, my 30 day healing journey is in the link in my bio.
